instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to perform a tensile analysis of a rectangular solid block. Use the N-mm-MPa unit system.

Geometry:
Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Sketch a rectangle from (0, 0) to (12, 8) in the Y-Z plane. Extrude along the global X-axis to a length of 120 mm. This creates a block with cross-section 12 mm x 8 mm and length 120 mm.

Material:
Create a material named Aluminum. Set Young's modulus E = 70000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.33. Create a Solid Homogeneous section and assign it to the entire block.

Assembly:
Create one dependent instance of the block.

Step:
Create a Static, General step named Step-Load.

Load:
Apply an Encastre boundary condition to the end face at X = 0. Apply a uniform pressure of 8.33 MPa on the end face at X = 120 mm in the positive X direction. This pressure is equivalent to a total tensile force of 800 N.

Mesh:
Apply a global seed size of 4 mm. Assign element type C3D8R and generate the mesh.

Job:
Create a job named Job-BlockTension, submit it for analysis, and wait for successful completion.

Visualization:
Review the S11 stress contour at the mid-section (X approximately 60 mm). Query the U1 displacement at the center of the free end face (X = 120 mm, Y = 6 mm, Z = 4 mm).

Save:
Save the model database to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-BlockTension.cae and ensure the output database is generated as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-BlockTension.odb.
